AdmissionView.description:
A service's admission and autoscaler state (decision D-A3): the adaptive concurrency limit,
what runs and waits, and what the autoscaler has learned.

demand.description: Decaying peak of running tasks (warm capacity follows it).

idle_ms.description: Milliseconds since the service last started or finished a task.

instances.description: Instances running now: concurrently running copies of the service (the same as `running`).

kind.description: Kind of the service's latest task: `deno` | `wasm` | `build`.

oneOf.description: The latest move of the limit and why; `null` if it never moved.

latency_baseline_ms.description: Latency baseline (ms) the autoscaler holds the limit against; `null` before samples.

max_instances.description:
Most instances at once (`scaling.max_instances`, the plan's `max_instances`, the profile
ceiling and the tenant cap): the same as `max`; excess requests queue.

max_queued.description: Bound of the service's wait queue (over it `503 overloaded`).

min.description: Bounds of the limit (`scaling.min` .. the ceiling and the plan's tenant cap).

min_instances.description:
Instances kept warm and floor of the limit (`scaling.min_instances`, within the plan's
`max_instances`; 0 = scales to zero when idle).

pred_background_ms.description: Predicted slot time (ms) of a background task (queue, stream, schedules); `null` before samples.

pred_ms.description: Predicted slot time (ms) of an interactive task (HTTP, calls, pub/sub); `null` before samples.

queue_timeouts.description: `503 queue_timeout` answers since the state was created.

queue_wait_ms.description:
Smoothed wait (ms) of the requests that had to queue; fades to 0 while requests start
without waiting.

queued.description: Tasks waiting for a run slot, and the bytes charged to them.

rps.description: Smoothed arrival rate, requests per second.

target_instances.description:
Warm instances the autoscaler wants kept ready in total (`warm_per_proc` times the
processors of the kind; at least `min_instances` once the service has run).

warm_per_proc.description: Warm instances the autoscaler asks each processor of the kind to keep (0 = scale to zero).

body.description: A JSON string is stored as its text, any other JSON value as its serialization.

dedup_id.description: The same id on the topic within 2 minutes returns the original offset.

key.description: Records with the same key go to the same partition.

duplicate.description: `true` when `dedup_id` matched an earlier record (nothing was appended).

last_restored_at.description: The `node.restored` event: this data directory came out of an archive then.

BundleView.description: What a client sees of an export while it runs and when it failed.

attempt.description: Failed deliveries of the record at `committed`.

next.description: Offset of the next append to the partition.

ConsumerView.description: A `(topic, group)` consumer of a service.

code_of_parent.description:
Start from the parent's live version: adopted by digest and live on the branch before this
call answers (`deploy`). Default none: the branch has no code until a push. A parent with
nothing live leaves it so.

copy_data.description: Copy the parent's data and blobs (`data:admin`; forces `access: key`). Default empty.

egress_of_parent.description: Keep the parent's egress rules (default); `false` allows no host.

env_names_from_parent.description: Add the names of the parent's env and secrets with empty values. Never a value.

environment.description: One of the project's environments; default a new label `br-<name>`, removed with the branch.

events_of_parent.description:
Keep the parent's pub/sub subscriptions and stream consumers (`deploy`). Default none: in a
shared environment the branch would answer messages meant for the parent.

oneOf.description: Delete the branch and its data after this time (unix ms).

schedules.description: Let interval and cron triggers run. Default off.

environments.description: Environments the key may touch (`null` = all environments).

project_ids.description: Projects the key may touch (`prj_…` ids of the tenant; `null` = all projects).

environments.description:
Environments services of the project may be in (default `["production"]`): 1 to 20 labels
matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$`.

slug.description: `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,62}$`; unique per tenant, cannot be changed.

allowed_hosts.description: Hosts its code may reach. Default none.

copy_data.description: Copy the parent's data and blobs (`data:admin`; forces `access: key`). Default empty.

oneOf.description: Delete it and its data at this time (unix ms); at most `scratch_ttl_max` away.

name.description: `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,23}$` without `--`, part of the slug. Default `preview`.

of.description: The service to mirror (`svc_…`); its config, never its secrets. Absent: stands alone.

project.description: Project of a preview without `of` (default project otherwise).

runtime.description: `deno` or `wasm`; required without `of`, refused with it.

call.description:
`{"allowed_callers": ["<slug>" | "svc_…" | "env:<name>", …]}`: who may call this service
(empty = same-environment services of the tenant).

deno.description: Deno knobs: `{"reuse_isolates": bool}` (unset = node config, then the profile's value).

durable.description:
A durable service: its objects are chosen in code (`durable.get(name)`), each with its own
storage and alarm, events and requests one at a time per object (default false).

environment.description:
Environment label, `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$` (default `production`); one of the project's
environments.

events.description:
Pub/sub subscriptions and stream consumers: `{"subscribe": [{"subject", "group"?}],
"consume": [{"topic", "group", "start", "batch_size", "max_attempts", "on_exhausted"}]}`.
Needs the plan to allow the `pubsub` / `stream` triggers; refused for durable services.

project.description: Project to create the service in: its slug or `prj_…` id (default `default`).

wasm.description: WASM knobs: `{"reuse_instances": bool}` (unset = the profile's value).

CreateTokenBody.description:
`POST /v1/keys`: the scopes and project and environment restrictions must be within the
creating key's own; an omitted `project_ids` / `environments` / `expires_at` is the creating
key's own restriction / expiry.

environments.description: Limit the key to these environments (a subset of the creating key's restriction).

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in the future, not later than the creating key's own expiry.

project_ids.description: Limit the key to these projects (`prj_…` ids; a subset of the creating key's restriction).

scopes.description: Scopes such as `services:read`, `deploy`; each one the creating key holds.

max_mb.description: Size cap of this topic in MiB; `0` (default) = only the tenant cap.

kv_prefixes.description: The subscribed KV prefixes as configured.

lag.description: Age in milliseconds of the oldest change not yet published.

warnings.description: Subscribed tables that do not exist yet, or are too wide for `row`.

key.description: The key as text, when it is UTF-8; else null.

key_b64.description: The key, base64url: the path segment of `GET …/data/kv/{key}`.

preview.description: The value's first 128 bytes: text for `json`, hex for `bytes`.

value.description: At most 128 KiB: text for `json`, hex for `bytes`.

args.description: Bound parameters: null, booleans, numbers, strings.

cell_max.description: Bytes kept of a text cell, up to 65536 (default 4096).

sql.description: One read-only statement that returns rows.

rows.description:
Cells: JSON values; integers beyond 2^53 and non-finite reals as strings; `{"$blob": size,
"hex": first 64 bytes}`; text over `cell_max` as `{"$text", "size", "truncated": true}`.

truncated.description: More rows exist than fit in `limit` or `max_bytes`.

rows_estimate.description: Taken without a scan: `sqlite_stat1`, else `MAX(rowid)`, else null.

body.description: JSON when the body parses as JSON, else a string.

EffectiveSdkView.description: An SDK the caller's grants allow, and the release they select (tenant view).

version.description: The release a call runs now; `null` when none satisfies the grants (`reason`).

ErrorEnvelope.description: The envelope returned for every control error.

activate.description: `after_build`: make it live once the build is ready, migrations first.

headers.description: Sent to the URL's origin only: dropped on a cross-origin redirect, never kept.

sha256.description: Expected digest of the bytes fetched: 64 hex digits, `sha256:` optional.

strip_components.description: Leading path components to drop (`1` for a GitHub tarball). Default 0.

subdir.description: After stripping: the directory that is the source root.

url.description: `https` only. Its query and userinfo are used for the fetch and never kept.

created_at.description: Unix ms when the claim was made.

expires_at.description: Unix ms when a pending claim expires (`hosts.pending_ttl`); `null` once active.

versions.description: Builds run in the background: follow `GET …/versions`.

warnings.description: `missing_secrets` when the bundle's secret names have no values here yet.

InvocationCountsView.description: Pending and failed records of a service.

InvocationView.description: One async invocation, without its request headers, body or query.

has_query.description: The request had a query string (not shown).

path.description: The request path, without the query.

status.description: Status of the last delivery that answered.

KeyCreated.description: Returned once at creation; `GET …/keys` never shows the secret again (API-13).

LimitChangeView.description: One move of a service's concurrency limit (`admission.last_change`).

reason.description:
What moved it: `queue` (requests waited), `trend` (arrival rate rose fast), `latency`,
`memory`, `cpu`, `idle` (unused limit decays), `bounds` (the service or its plan changed).

LimitsView.description: `GET /v1/limits`: the tenant's plan limits and what is left of them today.

day.description: UTC day the daily counters belong to (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

resets_at.description: Unix ms when the daily counters reset.

schedules.description: `plan.max_schedules` applies per service: `used` is the most schedules any one service has.

fields.description: Structured fields of a `std:log` record; absent on plain records.

MeView.description: `GET /v1/me`: who the credentials are and what they may do.

environments.description: Environments the key is limited to (`null` = every environment).

key_id.description: The key (`key_…`) of a tenant principal.

oneOf.description: The tenant's effective plan; `null` for the operator without `x-rt-tenant`.

project_ids.description: Projects the key is limited to (`prj_…` ids; `null` = every project of the tenant).

tenant_id.description: The tenant acted on: the key's tenant, or the operator's `x-rt-tenant`.

MigrationView.description: One migration of a version, or one that ran.

pending_for_latest.description: What the newest version would run, in order.

NodeHost.description:
`status.host`. A value the platform cannot give (macOS, no cgroup) is `null`. No host path
appears here: the disk carries a label.

cpu_pct.description: Percent of all cores, since the last minute's sample.

storage_bytes.description: Bytes of service data on disk, from the last storage scan.

NodeSeries.description: In memory only: after a restart the points begin at the restart.

NodeSockets.description:
`status.sockets`: open sockets, objects holding them, accepted sockets not connected yet, and
the node's cap (`ws.max_sockets`).

NodeStatsItem.description:
One service of `GET /v1/node/stats`. Percentiles are milliseconds of the total time, `null`
with `fields=counts`.

oneOf.description: Host facts; `null` on a node that does not sample them.

storage.description: The object has durable storage (keys or an alarm).

OnceScheduleView.description: A pending one-off schedule (`std:schedule`). Its payload and enabled flag are not listed.

run_at.description: Unix ms when the schedule is due.

PatchProjectBody.description: Each provided field replaces that field.

environments.description: The complete new list. Dropping an environment a service is in is `409 environment_in_use`.

PatchServiceBody.description: Top-level block merge: each provided block replaces that block.

environment.description: Environment label, `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$`; one of the service's project's environments.

events.description:
Pub/sub subscriptions and stream consumers: `{"subscribe": [{"subject", "group"?}],
"consume": [{"topic", "group", "start", "batch_size", "max_attempts", "on_exhausted"}]}`.
Needs the plan to allow the `pubsub` / `stream` triggers; refused for durable services.

project.description:
The service's current project (slug or `prj_…` id). A service cannot move between
projects: any other project is `422`.

PlanView.description: One plan from the node config (`GET /v1/plans`), or a tenant's effective plan (`GET /v1/me`).

settings.description:
The plan's settings (`max_services`, `rps`, `limits_max`, `custom_host_suffixes`, …); in
`/v1/me` with the tenant's overrides applied.

channel.description: Point this channel at the release (default: `stable` for the SDK's first release).

content_type.description:
The upload's format, as for a version upload (default `application/typescript` for Deno,
`application/wasm` for WASM).

contract.description:
The `.d.ts` tenants download (default: generated from the `defineSdk` methods). Required
for a WASM SDK, with `members`.

members.description: Top-level contract names (default: from the `defineSdk` methods).

dropped.description: Subscribers it was not delivered to (fan-out cap, quota, backlog, refused).

receivers.description: Subscribers the message was handed to.

path.description: Relative to the node's prefix for this tenant, project and environment.

QuotaView.description: One quota: the plan's limit and what is used.

next.description: Offset to pass as `from` for the next page.

body.description: JSON when the body parses as JSON, else a string.

to.description: `"earliest"`, `"latest"`, an offset (integer) or an RFC 3339 timestamp.

payload.description: JSON handed to the handler; on `PATCH` an absent payload keeps the current one.

previous.description: The version it pointed to before the last move (`21ci sdk rollback`).

SdkGrantBody.description: A grant: what a scope may use of an SDK (or of all, `*`). A field left out or `null` inherits.

version_req.description:
Semver requirement (`^1`, `~1.4`, `1.4.2`, `*`). An `allow` without one is pinned to the
major of the SDK's stable release (a new major is a grant change).

channels.description: The channels that point at it.

version_no.description: The SDK service's version that runs it.

service_id.description: Its service in the system tenant.

oneOf.description:
Queueing and autoscaler state; `null` while the service has none (never run, or idle
long enough to be forgotten).

inflight.description: Tasks of the service holding a run slot now.

async.description: The `async` block; omitted while no knob is set.

deno.description: `{"reuse_isolates": bool}`; omitted while no Deno knob is set.

dry_run.description: `PUT …/live` with `dry_run`: nothing changed, this is the service as it is.

durable.description: A durable service (its objects are chosen in code).

environment.description: Environment label (default `production`), one of the project's environments.

events.description: The `events` block; omitted while it has no subscription or consumer.

ingress_warnings.description: Create and `PATCH`: the ingress rules were stored, but may not do what they look like.

migrations_applied.description: `PUT …/live`: the migrations that ran before the flip.

pending_migrations.description: `PUT …/live` with `dry_run`: the migrations that ran on a copy of the data, in order.

project_id.description: Id of the project the service belongs to (`prj_…`).

switch_id.description: The switch this flip wrote (`PUT /v1/services/{s}/live` only).

warnings.description: What the flip could not finish; empty and absent normally.

wasm.description: `{"reuse_instances": bool}`; omitted while no WASM knob is set.

ws.description: `{"allowed_origins": […], "warm": bool, "max_sockets": n}`; omitted while no WebSocket knob is set.

SetLiveAccepted.description:
`202` of `PUT /v1/services/{s}/live`: the switch with `?async=1`; otherwise the service, after a
flip whose route refresh is delayed.

close_sockets.description:
Close the service's WebSockets with 1012 once the version is live (default false: they
stay open and the next event runs this version).

dry_run.description: Run the pending migrations on a copy of the data and report; change nothing (`200`).

migrate.description: Run pending SQL migrations first (default true). `false` needs scope `data:admin`: repair.

close_sockets.description: Close the service's WebSockets with 1012 once the version is live (default false).

drain_timeout.description: How long to wait for the previous version's tasks, e.g. `10m`; capped by the node.

dry_run.description: Check and report; write nothing (`200`, no `id`).

oneOf.description: The branch `<name>`, the service `<parent-slug>-br-<name>`; its live version.
Another service of the project; its live version unless one is named.
One of this service's own versions.

SwitchFrom.description: What to switch to. Never a digest: that is read from the source's row.

SwitchSourceView.description: The version a switch came from.

digest.description: `sha256:…` of the code; absent once the adopted version was collected.

SwitchView.description: One tracked flip of a live version.

inflight_old.description: Tasks of the previous version still running (0 when not draining or not known).

interrupted.description: The node restarted while this switch was unfinished.

pending_migrations.description: On a dry run: the migrations this switch would run, in order.

to_version.description: Absent on a dry run whose source was not adopted yet.

SwitchWarning.description: A flip committed, but one of its follow-ups did not finish.

code.description:
`routes_refresh_delayed`: the new version is committed and reaches traffic once the node
re-reads its routes, which it keeps trying. `env_missing_on_parent`: env or secret names the
source has and the parent lacks. `triggers_differ`: trigger switches that differ; config
does not move with a switch.

names.description: What the code is about; names only, never a value.

TelemetryReport.description: Exactly what is sent: these seven keys and nothing else.

requests.description: Requests finished in the last 24 hours.

users.description: Console users; `null` when no console reported in the last 48 hours.

TenantUsageView.description: `GET /v1/usage`: the tenant's whole effective plan and its current use, for the console.

day.description: UTC day the daily counters belong to (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

limits.description: Every key of the effective `[plans.<name>]`, tenant overrides applied.

resets_at.description: Unix ms when the daily counters reset.

parent_key_id.description:
The key that created this one through `POST /v1/keys`; revoking it revokes this one too.
`null` for keys the operator created.

TokenView.description: A key as `GET /v1/keys` lists it: the usual view plus the key that minted it.

TopicConsumer.description: A consumer group of a service on the topic.

lag.description: Records not yet committed, summed over partitions.

TopicHead.description: `first` = first retained offset, `next` = offset of the next append.

schedules.description: `used` is the service with the most schedules.

secrets.description: `used` is the service with the most secrets.

VersionInfo.description: `GET /v1/version`: what any authenticated caller may know about the node.

api.description: Version of the control API document (`info.version` of `/v1/openapi.json`).

build_state.description: `fetching` (`from-url`: the archive is on its way) | `pending` | `building` | `ready` | `failed`.

meta.description:
What the deploy claims (`{"git":{"sha","ref","repo","author","message"},"label"}`). Not
verified: render it as text and label it as claimed.

migrations.description: The SQL migrations this version carries, in order; absent without any.

source_digest.description: `null` until the source is here: while `fetching`, and after a fetch that failed.

warnings.description: What activating this version could not finish; empty and absent normally.
